premiere._note: The 16x9 MOGRT in Premiere against the same variant rendered in AE. The card's globe turns in the hold, so every Premiere frame is taken where the globe stands still or in the intro. B is 26.16 s long: Premiere stretches the hold (from 1.92 s) three times, so clip c is master 1.92 + (c − 1.92) / 3 and every third frame lands on a master frame — clip 8.16 s is master 4.0 s and clip 24.48 s master 9.44 s, both with the globe still (the stripes drift all the time: the times must be exact). C plays at 2×: its decoration runs at 2× to 0.72 s, then in real time. D has texts of its own, typed in lower case, with a line longer than the pack's box (the block fits).
